{ "rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is strongly positive to correct mean reversion bias",
    "Adjust forecasts upward when sentiment is strongly negative to avoid undershooting lows",
    "Compress forecast range relative to model output to reduce initial overshoot",
    "Accelerate convergence of forecasts to historical levels, especially in trending markets",
    "Scale sentiment impact by forecast magnitude to prevent excessive trades at flat prices",
    "Reduce forecast volatility by smoothing rapid price changes",
    "Correct directional errors within 3-5 day lookahead by 50% of initial deviation"
] }
